method: Reopened transformed Blend mesh. For each component, exclude only its own triangles and ray-cast every actual vertex in8 fixed directions against ALL other component triangles. No camera/material adjustments. Positive visibility is necessary, not sufficient, for meaningful pixel readability.
limitations: Sparse-direction geometric exposure, not complete screen-space occlusion nor independent visual/factual acceptance. Tiny visible fractions are disclosed, not converted to arbitrary pass thresholds.
